titolo: Claude assists creation of Python homelab diagram tool on GitHub
descr: A new repo uses Claude to generate a Python script that turns a YAML inventory into SVG/PNG network diagrams.
paragrafi: Goblinmine released homelab-diagram, a Python project that converts a YAML inventory into a detailed SVG or PNG network diagram.
The code was written together with Claude (Anthropic) in Claude Code; the user described the desired output and Claude produced and refined the script.
The tool requires Python 3.11+, PyYAML and optionally Pillow; it also uses rsvg-convert to create PNG files and embeds service icons downloaded by fetch_icons.py.
Layout coordinates are hard‑coded in build.py, so the diagram matches the author’s specific lab; users must adjust coordinates for their own setups.
Claude Code can be used to adapt the repository: it can interview the user, rewrite inventory.yaml and build.py, and iterate on renders.
perche: The project shows how AI can speed up custom scripting for infrastructure visualisation, lowering the barrier for hobbyists. It also illustrates a practical example of using a free, locally run model like Claude to generate usable code without needing a paid service.
titoloFonte: Goblinmine/homelab-diagram: Renders an r/homelab-style network diagram from a YAML inventory (Python → SVG/PNG). Written with Claude.
